Name: Looking for Love - 1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits Edits
Author: IBSammy
Description:
talkohlooeys' has given permission for people to make edits to their work, and so I did. This is my fourth one, converting [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking for Love[/url] to work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url].

[u][b]Install Instructions:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*]Install both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10206]Looking for Love[/url]﻿ and their requirements
[*]Unzip my folder from wherever you saved it
[*]Copy contents from this unzipped folder to \Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\﻿
[/list]

Downloads.Description:
This is original Pam, if you decided you don't like the Hot Pam I added originally to this mod. Download the Main Mod, and then this one. When prompted, just overwrite the contents.

The update just edits her blushing portrait a bit.
